description: Florida payroll figures for 2026. Florida has no state personal income tax; employers pay reemployment (unemployment) tax.

sources.title: Florida Department of Revenue, Reemployment Tax Rate Information
sources.revision: page as supplied 2026-09-30 (no revision date shown)

incomeTaxWithholding.note: Florida has no state personal income tax.

unemployment.note: New employers pay 2.7% until they have enough history for an earned rate. The employer's own rate comes from its Form RT-20 rate notice (entered in Payroll > Setup). Minimum and maximum apply to wages paid in 2026; a higher rate may apply to delinquent employers.

cite.ref: Reemployment Tax Rate Information: initial rate 2.7%; 2026 minimum 0.1% and maximum 5.4% on annual wages up to $7,000 per employee

unemployment.note: Pay for services is subject to unemployment tax. How pre-tax deductions, tips, reimbursements and company contributions are treated is not in the supplied documents; paychecks with them are refused until sourced.

ownerApproval.scope: Figures checked as copied from the supplied documents, for building and testing the tax calculations. Not a professional review: reviewedBy stays null until a CPA or payroll specialist signs off, which is required before real paychecks.

note: The source is a web page without a revision date; the page's 2026 statement is cited.
